schedule.intro: He reads availability, payroll caps, last week's trades, and the weather — then drops a full week of shifts in under a minute. Approve in one tap, or let it auto-commit.
reasons: Sarah opens Mon — she's flagged "early-bird" in availability.
Mateo on close — 1h overlap with Sarah for handover.
Priya leads Tue AM — payday lift forecast +14%.
Sarah doubles Tue PM — Mateo unavailable after 1 pm.
Mateo opens Wed — Sarah requested mid-week PM.
Devon trains Wed PM — first solo close (Priya nearby).
Thursday rush — senior on bar opens cleaner.
Sarah closes Thu — coverage gap solved without OT.
Mateo Fri AM — weather says +22% iced drinks.
Priya extended close — payday + Friday happy hour.
Devon Sat AM — soft demand, good day to keep training.
Sarah Sat close — Mateo flagged Sat PTO last month.
Priya solo Sun AM — brunch crowd, predictable mix.
Mateo wraps the week — Sun close keeps payroll under cap.

pos.intro: The Merchiva register shares the same catalog and stock counts as your dashboard. Every sale updates the forecast in the same second — no overnight sync.

features.headPre: Six things our forecast does that

F01.title: Per-SKU demand
F01.body: A separate model per SKU per location. Daily and hourly granularity, refit nightly on your data.

F02.title: Confidence bands
F02.body: Forecasts come with calibrated 80/95% intervals. Decide reorder qty against your tolerance for stockout.

F03.title: Drivers explained
F03.body: Every prediction shows what moved it: weather, payday, holiday, local event, last week's lift.

F04.title: Auto-reorder
F04.body: Suggested POs land in your inbox at 4am. Approve in one tap. Vendor-aware lead times, MOQs, pack sizes.

F05.title: Stockout alerts
F05.body: A pager-style alert the moment risk crosses your threshold. Quietly resolves itself when you reorder.

F06.title: Cold-start mode
F06.body: New SKU? We borrow strength from similar items in the network until you have your own history.

quotes.q: Closed our first month with no spreadsheet for the first time in 6 years.
Replaced four logins. The crew actually uses it because the punch screen is faster than the wall clock.
Inventory used to be Wednesday night and a glass of wine. Now it's Wednesday afternoon.

cta.para: Connect your POS. We learn your sales for seven days, then start telling you what to order — to the case, by the day. Median forecast error: 7.2%.
